statements.statement: The patient has a history of unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91)
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The syncopal episodes are poorly correlated with standard ECG findings
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
